description: This file defines an abstract class AbstractLocalizedConverter that extends another converter class and implements local-specific conversion methods, handling locale and timezone information for conversions.

classes.name: AbstractLocalizedConverter
classes.description: An abstract class providing localized conversion functionalities between source type S and target type T, handling locale and timezone parameters.

methods.name: convert
methods.description: Converts an object of type S to type T considering the locale and timezone, potentially with a format string.
